Hi Olivia / Simon —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and a clear next step. I’ve pulled the notes into high-level bullets below.

What we heard
- Current stack: Postgres + homegrown ETL; planning to add real-time analytics for claims processing.
- Primary pain: inference latency during peak batch jobs and rising token costs for large-scale NER/runbook tasks.
- Goals: 75% reduction in tail latency for transform pipelines; predictable per-request cost; ability to host in VPC.
- Evaluation criteria: latency under 200ms p50 for short queries, SOC2 compliance, and clear migration path from current infra.

Proposed next steps
1) 30-minute intro demo (product tour + short Q&A) — goal: align stakeholders on fit and next-level technical needs.
2) 60-minute technical deep dive (optional) — include engineering and SRE for KV/cache, batching behavior, and deployment options.

Please pick one of these 30-min windows next week (all PT):
- Tue 2026-02-24 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 2026-02-25 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 2026-02-26 09:00–09:30 PT

If none of those work, reply with preferred times and I’ll send a calendar invite. I’ve attached a one-pager that highlights the latency/cost controls we discussed.

Also copying Ben (solutions) and Stephanie (AE) so they can join the demo or the technical deep dive as appropriate.

Best,

Camila Reyes
